verdict.rationale: Stark Bank is a banking API platform, so natural-language operation is a fair axis. The evidence shows only a REST/JSON API, SDKs, and LLM-readable docs (llms.txt, markdown). These are developer building blocks for constructing such an interface, not a natural-language command capability the product ships itself.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands
